units.source_text: 这女子是从一幢宏伟的西班牙式宅邸的分门走出来的。

en.t: The woman had come out through the side gate of a magnificent Spanish-style mansion.

units.source_text: 这幢宅邸有两个烟囱，有斜格子玻璃窗，还有宽阔的温室玻璃屋顶，的确给人一种容易破损的印象。

en.t: The mansion had two chimneys, diagonal lattice glass windows, and a broad glass roof over a greenhouse, which truly gave it an impression of fragility.

units.source_text: 隔着马路的体育场一侧，耸立着一面铁丝网，当然这无疑是由于宅邸的主人的抗议而架设起来的。

en.t: On the athletic field side across the road, a wire fence rose up, and of course it had undoubtedly been erected because of protests from the mansion's owner.
